title: Admission pressure and peak exercise heart rate: an exploratory cross-state interaction test across Cleveland and Hungary
abstract: Adding one admission-SBP × age-normalized peak-HR interaction changed Hungarian Brier loss from 0.131724 to 0.130695 (delta -0.001029; joint source-refit/target bootstrap95% [-0.008601,+0.011552]); incremental benefit was not established. This is an exploratory independent-site evaluation of previously explored UCI cohorts, not untouched confirmation. The asynchronous feature is not measured exercise rate-pressure product. Training uncertainty and influence checks undermine a robust improvement claim.
